title: A Journal of the First Voyage of Vasco da Gama, 1497–1499
version: Hakluyt Society translation, Project Gutenberg transcription.
lineage: Historical primary voyage narrative through a nineteenth-century edition. Narrative pp. 45–50 inspected, keeping editorial notes distinct. The narrator’s Christian label is unreliable; no name, religion, ethnicity or Ibn Majid identification is assigned. Pilot supplied after a king’s servant was detained; no voluntary or equal exchange is inferred. The episode dates one application, not the origin of Indian Ocean navigation.

passages.locator: p. 46, Across the Gulf—the Arabian Sea, opening
passages.quote: with the pilot whom the king had given us
passages.note: The fleet departed Malindi on 24 April 1498 with the locally supplied pilot.
The narrative includes a coastal identification error rather than depicting an infallible pilot.
